D.t: Gwen Moore leads by 61.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 231,503 votes; a one point swing is about 1,872 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +57.3 and D +66.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
